newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Generale Bank optimistic about 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank optimistic about 1997 earnings.

text.p: Generale Bank, Belgium's biggest bank, said it was optimistic on earnings growth in 1997.

"For 1997, several indicators point to an improvement of the economic context and of a favourable orientation of interest rates in the countries in which the bank is active ... barring unexpected events on monetary and financial markets, we can expect a continued improvement of the bank's net profit per share," the bank said in its annual report, which was released on Thursday.
The bank's 1996 group net profit rose 10.4 percent to 15.10 billion francs from 13.67 billion in 1995.

The annual report made no mention of possible partnership agreements or alliances with other banks. At the presentation of the 1996 results last month, the bank said it was not against an alliance with a partner, notably fellow Belgian bank Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL).
